variants.title: Native Mint
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE beautiful production-quality portrait PNG concept of a Linux/XFCE-inspired workspace designed specifically for a tall touchscreen phone inside Termux Job’s X11, approximately 1024x2048. Desktop/workspace viewport ONLY, no physical phone, no Android status/navigation bars, no outer app chrome, no collage or captions outside the screen. It must feel coherent with Termux Job’s: near-black charcoal, pale text and refined mint/turquoise accents, rounded rectangular surfaces, precise thin outlines, restrained effects. Large legible typography, comfortable finger-sized controls, spacious icon spacing, no tiny old PC toolbars. This is a creative visual concept, not a screenshot of an existing OS. Show a credible Linux Files or Terminal workspace with readable English labels; make the bottom thumb area especially comfortable. All window controls have correct proportions and smooth borders, no jagged edges, no square opaque patches behind round buttons. Include tasteful subtle italic branding ‘Termux-job’s’, ‘&’, ‘X11’ on three lines in free wallpaper space where appropriate; never place it over important controls. No Windows, Kali, Apple or Android logos, no dragons or hacking clichés. A >_ Termux-like symbol is the app/menu mark. High visual fidelity, original wallpaper and icons, careful consistency. Variant 1: NATIVE MINT — the believable evolution of our current desktop using the app’s own design language. Sophisticated matte almost-black background with a subtle sweeping teal light ribbon low on the screen; thin mint borders, graphite rounded panels. Compact top task strip with a Files tab and status indicators. Four large simple softly shaded mint-outline desktop shortcuts on the left. One elegant dark Files window at the upper third: mint hairline outline, large circular minimize/maximize/close controls, roomy breadcrumb /sdcard, a refined sidebar and three big folder tiles Documents Downloads Pictures. The center/lower wallpaper remains peaceful with restrained white italic three-line brand. A floating bottom dock inside one wide rounded rectangle: >_ Menu, Files, Terminal, Browser, each very large and clearly separated; small neat clock. Uncluttered, practical, crisp, premium but restrained. Feasible XFCE theme aesthetic, not a busy futuristic control panel.

Variant 2: TOUCH WORKSPACE — rethink the desktop for thumb control rather than shrinking a PC. Bottom thumb toolbar includes a large >_ Menu button, workspace switch and a clearly visible keyboard button. Cohesive intentionally touch-first Linux shell concept, no standard tiny title bars, no fake mouse cursor. Calm spacious hierarchy and genuinely readable controls; show less information beautifully. Place small italic Termux-job’s / & / X11 branding subtly in background negative space, not repeating the main app title heavily.
